project_info.name: DayStack
project_info.aesthetic: Tactical Minimalism, Objectivity, Speed, Deep Obsidian Black

design_principles: Content over chrome: Eliminate all unnecessary borders, cards, and backgrounds. Use negative space (padding) as the primary separator.
High contrast: Pure or near-pure whites (#FAFAFA) on deep voids (#09090B) to ensure rapid legibility, inspired by high-end aviation/military HUDs.
Touch precision: Minimum touch targets of 48x48px. Hit slop values applied to icons.
No friction: Immediate interactions, binary states, no loading spinners for local storage operations.
Unobtrusive motion: Subtle scaling on press, buttery bottom-sheet slides. No bouncing or springy overshoots.

headings.description: Bold, clean, slightly utilitarian sans-serif. Used for headers, dates, and numbers.

body.description: Legible, technical sans-serif for task titles, notes, and metadata.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale adapted for Mobile). Do not cramp elements.

navigation.bottom_tab_bar: Solid background (#18181B in dark mode) with NO top border. Use optical alignment for icons. Active tab icon: #FAFAFA, Inactive: #52525B. No text labels.
navigation.quick_add_fab: Do not use a floating circle. Use a dedicated central tab or a persistent bottom bar input area to avoid overlapping lists.

task_list_item.style: Flat, cardless. separated by 1px subtle border-bottom (#27272A).
task_list_item.layout: Row flex, align-center. Left: 24x24px outline circle (toggle). Middle: Task title (16px). Right: Category dot or due date.
task_list_item.completed_state: Text color changes to text_tertiary (#52525B) with line-through. Circle filled with text_tertiary.
task_list_item.swipe_actions: Swipe left to reveal Destructive Red (#EF4444) trash block. Swipe right to schedule.

progress_header.style: Massive typography. '5 of 8' in text-4xl font-black. 'tasks completed' in text-sm uppercase.
progress_header.visual: A 2px high full-width progress bar (#27272A background, #FAFAFA fill).

modals_and_sheets.add_edit_task: Use an Expo BottomSheet (e.g., @gorhom/bottom-sheet). Snap points: 50%, 90%. Drag handle: 4px high, 32px wide pill (#52525B). No title bar, just a massive text input for the task name right at the top.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black (Dark mode) or bg-black text-white (Light mode). h-14 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg.

inputs.style: No borders. Massive text size (text-2xl) for main task input. For notes/details: text-base with text_secondary color.

Home.header: Today's Date (e.g., 'Wed, Oct 24') in small uppercase, followed by giant Progress Header.
Home.upcoming: A muted section below today's tasks showing the next 5 tasks. Opacity 60%.

Tasks.header: Sticky header with horizontally scrollable pills for categories (All, Home, Work, Health).
Tasks.body: SectionList grouped by Recurring vs One-time.

Stats.layout: Bento-style grid (simulated with flex). Large blocks for 'Total Completed' (text-5xl) and 'Current Streak' (with a subtle fire emoji or icon). Weekly bar chart using plain Reanimated views or react-native-svg.

Settings.layout: Simple list of rows with right-aligned toggles. Theme (Dark/Light/System), Notifications. Minimalist About section with abstract texture background header.

icons_and_assets.library: phosphor-react-native or @expo/vector-icons (Feather). Prefer sharp, linear icons.
icons_and_assets.weight: Regular or Bold (do not use thin/light as they disappear in dark mode).
icons_and_assets.inspiration_image: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1770745560263-a8fc696de90b?crop=entropy&cs=srgb&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NjA2MTJ8MHwxfHNlYXJjaHwxfHxtaW5pbWFsaXN0JTIwZGFyayUyMGFic3RyYWN0JTIwdGV4dHVyZXxlbnwwfHx8fDE3NzQ1NzQ5Mzd8MA&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=85 (Use as faint texture behind Settings/Stats if needed)

motion_and_interactions.toggles: Immediate visual feedback. Haptic feedback (react-native-haptic-feedback) on completion toggle.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Expo Router default native transitions (slide from right).

accessibility_and_testing.screen_readers: All icon-only buttons MUST have accessibilityLabel.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a 'testID' attribute (e.g., testID='complete-task-button', testID='add-task-input', testID='nav-home-tab').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use NativeWind v4 (Tailwind for React Native) or standard StyleSheet for all styling.
Prioritize optical alignment over raw math. If an icon looks off-center, adjust its margins manually.
Do NOT use HTML elements (div, span). Use native elements (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, Pressable).
For the bottom sheet, use '@gorhom/bottom-sheet' or a custom Modal with react-native-reanimated to maintain the minimalist feel.
Ensure 'testID' is added to every pressable, text input, and major view for end-to-end testing.
Avoid default Expo blue everywhere. Stick to the monochromatic palette defined above.
When rendering lists, use FlatList or SectionList for performance, avoid mapping over large arrays in ScrollView.
